notes: All included songs have original words and music by Cornett dated within 2002–2026. Source score dates are not claimed to establish the first recording release. No lyrics or audio are included. Chord symbols and section boundaries were visually checked against the publisher scores. Numeric conversions round-trip exactly to the transcribed chord names.
